subject.title: Ensure transcript-to-client delivery consistency for channel-scoped sessions

question: What persistent receipt schema, adapter reconciliation contract, and Control UI/Gateway surface should OpenClaw use for transcript-entry to platform-message delivery state?
rationale: The issue is valid, but the fix crosses core persistence, channel SDK contracts, redelivery semantics, and user/operator UI, so automation should not choose that product/API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design core receipt ledger first
options.body: Define a core SQLite delivery receipt table/API and Control UI state model, then implement adapter-specific reconciliation against that contract.

options.title: Keep narrow queue mitigations only
options.body: Continue landing queue recovery fixes while leaving transcript-to-channel reconciliation as a later design item.

options.title: Use channel-specific fixes
options.body: Let each channel build its own delivery visibility behavior, accepting inconsistent operator state and reconciliation semantics.

recommendation.title: Design core receipt ledger first
recommendation.body: Define a core SQLite delivery receipt table/API and Control UI state model, then implement adapter-specific reconciliation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the SQLite queue and current central delivery/transcript code paths.
